###### Abstract

The dominant sequence transduction models are based on complex recurrent networks.

## 1 Introduction

Recurrent models compute hidden states sequentially \[[13](#bib.bib13)\], which precludes parallelization.

## 3 Model Architecture

![Refer to caption](https://arxiv.org/html/1706.03762v7/Figures/ModalNet-21.png)

Figure 1: The Transformer - model architecture.

#### 3.2.1 Scaled Dot-Product Attention

We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_k}$, and apply a softmax function.

|  | $$\mathrm{Attention}(Q,K,V)=\mathrm{softmax}(\frac{QK^{T}}{\sqrt{d_{k}}})V$$ |  | (1) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

For large values of $d_k$, the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax into regions with small gradients.
